g.title: Best Overall
g.text: A softly shaped ceramic lamp can work with a range of bedroom styles. Look
for a shade that diffuses the light comfortably and a base that leaves room
Check the full shade width as well as the base before deciding whether it fits

g.title: Best Budget
g.text: A simple table lamp can provide a useful finishing touch without dominating
the room. Consider the total cost, including any bulb or shade that must be
Price alone does not establish value. Confirm the materials, electrical

g.title: Best for Small Bedrooms
g.text: A compact lamp leaves more room for a book, water glass and other
essentials. Check both the shade diameter and the base footprint to
understand how much space it uses.
A small lamp still needs to put light where you want it. Compare its height with
the mattress and your reading position.

g.title: Best Modern
g.text: A sculptural lamp can act as a small focal point in a restrained bedroom.
Repeat one of its finishes elsewhere to connect it with the rest of the
Consider how the form looks when switched off as well as how it directs light

g.title: Best Minimalist
g.text: A slim lamp can suit a pared-back room where every object has a purpose. Pay
attention to the switch position and whether the light is comfortable for
A narrow profile does not guarantee a small base. Compare the complete dimensions

g.title: Best Statement Lamp
g.text: A substantial lamp can balance a wide bed or a generous bedside table. Keep
nearby objects simple so the overall arrangement remains calm.
Mark out the shade width before buying. Large lamps can crowd a surface even when

g.title: Best Space-Saving
g.text: A wall-mounted light moves the fixture off the nightstand. Think through the
mounting position, cable route and access to the switch before selecting a

What to Look for in a Bedside Lamp
Choose proportions that work with both your bed and your nightstand. Check
the shade width as well as the base.
Consider whether you need focused reading light, softer ambient light or a
Check the shade position from your usual seated or lying position so the
Choose a finish and silhouette that complements the room. Think about how
the lamp looks during daylight too.
